Adds a public prepareUpdate that parses and translates once and returns a reusable object, usable through Graph.update and evalUpdate. The candidate's own tests cover reuse across graphs (test/test_sparql_prepare.py:21-33), though those tests were not executed.
Preserves the original empty-update behaviour: algebra.py:752-754 returns Update(prologue, []), so SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update('') (processor.py:61-65) still works.

The reference does not: with an empty request it returns a bare list at reference algebra.py:751-752, and its evalUpdate at reference update.py:276 accesses .algebra, so g.update('') would raise AttributeError. The candidate avoids this regression.
